offset.description: Page number inside the requested collection. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list)

pageSize.description: Number of elements to display per page. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list)

filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/)
endpoint. Currently supported filters are:

+ status: Status the user has

+ group: Name of the group in which to-be-listed users are members.

+ name: Filter users in whose first or last names, or email addresses the given string occurs.

+ login: User's login (operations: list)

sortBy.description:
JSON specifying sort criteria.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. (operations: list)

select.description: Comma separated list of properties to include. (operations: list)

password.description:
The user's password.

*Conditions:*

Writable on create.

Writable on update only when:
- the caller updates their own account
- `currentPassword` is provided and valid (operations: create, update)

currentPassword.description:
The user's current password.

*Conditions:*

Required when changing `password` for a self update (`PATCH /api/v3/users/me` or `PATCH /api/v3/users/{id}` where `id` is the caller).

Ignored for non-self updates (for example, administrators updating other users). (operations: create, update)

status.description:
The current activation status of the user.

*Conditions:*

Only writable on creation, not on update. (operations: create, update)

id.description: User id. Use `me` to reference current user, if any. (operations: delete, get, update, update_form, unlock, lock)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
